buzzRounds.topic: Commanders beat the Bengals 22-20 on a last-second field goal Monday night
buzzRounds.whatHappened: The Washington Commanders beat the Cincinnati Bengals 22-20 on Monday Night Football. Jayden Daniels led a game-winning drive and Drew Stevens kicked a 26-yard field goal as time expired, his fifth field goal in five tries.
buzzRounds.whyCare: Cincinnati came in leading the AFC North and fell to 7-3, while Washington improved to 4-5-1. Joe Burrow threw for 300 yards and 2 touchdowns, but Washington outgained Cincinnati 428 yards to 312 and outran it 150 rushing yards to 31.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Washington beat Cincinnati 22-20 Monday night when Drew Stevens hit a 26-yard field goal as time ran out. It was his fifth field goal of the night without a miss.

details.name: Drew Stevens
details.buzz: Stevens made all 5 of his field-goal tries, including the 26-yarder as time expired to win it.

details.name: Jayden Daniels
details.buzz: Daniels threw for 289 yards and led the final drive that set up the winning kick.

details.name: Joe Burrow
details.buzz: Burrow threw for 300 yards and 2 touchdowns, but Cincinnati ran for only 31 yards as a team.

buzzRounds.whyCare: Prescott passed 3,000 yards for the 8th season of his career, and Lamb reached 50 career receiving touchdowns. Dallas moved to 5-6, while Tennessee fell to 1-9.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Dallas put up 51 points on Tennessee on Sunday. Dak Prescott missed only 5 of his 33 passes and had 5 touchdowns.

Tennessee Titans.latestResult: Lost 51-30 at the Dallas Cowboys in Week 11 (now 1-9)
Tennessee Titans.storyline: Tennessee scored 30 points but gave up 51 and 480 total yards in Dallas, falling to 1-9.
Tennessee Titans.bringUp: The Titans scored 30 in Dallas and still lost by 21, 51-30. Cam Ward completed 21 of 30 passes with 3 touchdowns.

details.name: Cam Ward
details.buzz: Ward completed 21 of 30 passes for 248 yards with 3 total touchdowns, but Dallas scored 51.

Washington Commanders.latestResult: Won 22-20 vs the Cincinnati Bengals in Week 11 (now 4-5-1)
Washington Commanders.storyline: Drew Stevens kicked a 26-yard field goal as time ran out on Monday night, after Jayden Daniels drove Washington 64 yards in 46 seconds.
Washington Commanders.bringUp: Washington beat the Bengals 22-20 on Monday night when Drew Stevens hit a 26-yard field goal with no time left, his fifth field goal of the game.

details.name: Jayden Daniels
details.buzz: Daniels led the last-second drive to set up the winning kick and also led the team with 55 rushing yards. He has 1,788 passing yards this season.

details.name: Drew Stevens
details.buzz: Stevens went 5 for 5 on field goals, including the 26-yard winner as time expired, and scored 16 points.
